title: Statutory Update : Paper 5 - Indirect Tax Laws (Statutory Update for November 2026 examination)
subject: IDT
law_cutoff_statement: The following are applicable for November 2026 examination: (i) The provisions of the CGST Act, 2017 and the IGST Act, 2017 as amended by the Finance Act, 2025 including significant notifications and circulars issued and other legislative amendments made, which have become effective up to 30.04.2026. (ii) The provisions of the Customs Act, 1962 and the Customs Tariff Act, 1975, as amended by the Finance Act, 2025 including significant notifications and circulars issued and other legislative amendments made, which have become effective up to 30.04.2026.
notes: PDF heading: 'PAPER 5: INDIRECT TAX LAWS STATUTORY UPDATE FOR NOVEMBER 2026 EXAMINATION'. It updates the September 2025 edition of the Study Material (law up to 30.04.2025) with GST and Customs notifications and circulars from 01.05.2025 to 30.04.2026, grouped by Study Material chapter. The May 2027 Study Material files in this set already include those changes, so this update is mostly redundant with them. A corrigendum for it, https://resource.cdn.icai.org/91152bos-aps3735-corrigendum.pdf, is listed on the same landing page but was not downloaded.

title: PAPER – 5: INDIRECT TAX LAWS – REVISION TEST PAPERS – NOVEMBER 2026 EXAMINATION
subject: IDT
law_cutoff_statement: All questions have been answered on the basis of position of (i) GST law as amended by the Finance Act, 2025 including significant notifications and circulars and other legislative amendments made, up to 30th April, 2026 and (ii) customs law as amended by the Finance Act, 2025 including significant notifications and circulars and other legislative amendments made, up to 30th April, 2026.
notes: Title is assembled from the printed page headers. On the landing page the link is labelled 'Paper-5: Indirect Tax Laws'. Despite the 'ch5' in the URL, this is the whole Paper 5 RTP. It mixes GST and Customs/FTP, with case-scenario MCQs and descriptive questions plus answers. Page numbers in the PDF start at about 32-33, so it is an extract from the combined Final RTP.

title: MODEL TEST PAPERS (RELEVANT FOR MAY, 2025 AND NOVEMBER 2025 EXAMINATIONS) FINAL COURSE GROUP - II
subject: IDT
law_cutoff_statement: All questions should be answered on the basis of the position of (i) GST law as amended by significant notifications/circulars issued and by the amendments made by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 which have become effective, till 31.10.2024 and (ii) Customs law as amended by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 and significant notifications/circulars and other legislative amendments made upto 31.10.2024.
notes: These are ICAI 'Model Test Papers', a published compilation, not the live MTP Series I/II. On the landing page the link is labelled 'Model Test Papers Group II'. The compilation also contains Paper 4 (Direct Tax Laws & International Taxation), which must be filtered out. Paper 5 IDT questions are on PDF pages 111-216 (Model Test Papers 1-6 start on pages 111, 128, 146, 162, 178 and 199). Paper 5 answers are on PDF pages 346-439 (Answers 1-6 start on pages 346, 362, 378, 393, 408 and 424). All other pages are Paper 4. The law_cutoff statement is identical in all six IDT papers. This law (up to 31.10.2024) is the oldest in the set.
